pvp_talents.name: Counterstrike Totem
pvp_talents.description:
Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec.

Whenever enemies within 20 yards of the totem deal direct damage, the totem will deal 100% of the damage dealt back to attacker.

pvp_talents.name: Electrocute
pvp_talents.description: When you successfully Purge a beneficial effect, the enemy suffers 2,154 Nature damage over 3 sec.

pvp_talents.name: Grounding Totem
pvp_talents.description: Summons a totem at your feet that will redirect all harmful spells cast within 30 yards on a nearby party or raid member to itself. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 3 sec.

pvp_talents.name: Rain Dance
pvp_talents.description: Healing Rain is now instant, 50% more effective, and costs 60% less mana.

pvp_talents.name: Master of the Elements
pvp_talents.description:
Casting Lava Burst increases the healing of your next Healing Wave by 30%, stacking up to 2 times.

Healing Wave applies Flame Shock to a nearby enemy when empowered by Master of the Elements.

pvp_talents.name: Static Field Totem
pvp_talents.description: Summons a totem with 4% of your health at the target location for 6 sec that forms a circuit of electricity that enemies cannot pass through.

pvp_talents.name: Burrow
pvp_talents.description:
Burrow beneath the ground, becoming unattackable, removing movement impairing effects, and increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

When the effect ends, enemies within 6 yards are knocked in the air and take 2,508 Physical damage.

pvp_talents.name: Storm Conduit
pvp_talents.description:
Casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift, Gust of Wind, Wind Shear, and Nature Totems by 1.0 sec.

Interrupt duration reduced by 65% on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning casts.

pvp_talents.name: Totem of Wrath
pvp_talents.description: Stormkeeper summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that increases the critical effect of damage and healing spells of all nearby allies within 40 yards by 15% for 15 sec.

pvp_talents.name: Call of Al'Akir
pvp_talents.description: Nature's Swiftness now also affects Hex, but its cooldown is increased by 30 sec.

pvp_talents.name: Lightning Lasso
pvp_talents.description: Grips the target in lightning, stunning and dealing 14,630 Nature damage over 5 sec while the target is lassoed. Can move while channeling.

pvp_talents.name: Shamanism
pvp_talents.description:
Your Heroism spell now has a 60 sec cooldown, but increases Haste by 15%, and only affects you and your friendly target when cast for 10 sec.

In addition, Heroism is no longer affected by Exhaustion.
